next.reason: Amendment 2 (X3.23b-1993, pages VI-96 and VI-97) renumbered this rule (old GR6) and its references ('general rules 10 and 13' to 12 and 15, 'general rule 13' to 15, 'paragraphs 6a through 6d' to 'general rules 7a through 7d'); the requirement is the printed one. §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR7 a to e recur in §2023:14.9.22.4 GR8 a to e; e is word for word ('This implied character is considered always to match the leftmost character of the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 participating in the current comparison cycle'), and a to d each gain a BACKWARD branch. a: 1985 'starting with the leftmost character position in the data item referenced by identifier-1', 2023 'starting with the leftmost character position, or, if BACKWARD is specified, the rightmost character position in the data item referenced by identifier-1'. b: 1985 'immediately to the right of the leftmost character position considered in the last comparison cycle', 2023 'immediately to the right, or if BACKWARD is specified to the left, of the leftmost character position considered in the last comparison cycle'. c: 1985 'immediately to the right of the rightmost character position that participated in the match', to which 2023 adds 'or, if BACKWARD is specified, the character position in the data item referenced by identifier-1 immediately to the left of the leftmost character position that participated in the match'. d: 1985 'The comparison operation continues until the rightmost character position of the data item referenced by identifier-1 has participated in a match or has been considered as the leftmost character position'; 2023 puts 'If BACKWARD was not specified' before those words and adds 'otherwise if BACKWARD has been specified, the comparison operation continues until the leftmost character position of the data item referenced by identifier-1 has participated in a match or has been considered as the rightmost character position'. Without BACKWARD, which is every 1985 INSPECT, the cycle starts, advances and ends the same. With it (§2023:14.9.22.2 prints an optional 'BACKWARD' before identifier-1; §1985:VI.6.18.2 prints identifier-1 directly after INSPECT, so 1985 refuses it) GR8 states where a right-to-left cycle starts, advances and ends, results the 1985 words do not state: a case added (family ruling). The earlier KEPT rested on the ground that the general format, not this rule, refuses BACKWARD, which the ruling rejects; nothing in this rule's own text sets it apart from 1985-GR-VI.6.18.4-2. 2023 c still prints 'General rules 12 and 15' and a.2 'General rules 12 and 17' where its replacing rule is GR17: numbering, no difference. 'to': GR8 states the whole rule; §2023:14.9.22.4 GR3 states the start and direction of the cycle in its own words ('Inspection (which includes the comparison cycle, the establishment of boundaries for the BEFORE or AFTER phrase' ... 'begins at the leftmost character position of the data item referenced by identifier-1, regardless of its class, and proceeds from left to right to the rightmost character position'). §2023:14.9.22.4 GR7 is not listed: this rule only refers to the rules that tally and replace ('tallying or replacing takes place as described in general rules 12 and 15').
